sentences.1: Buses in this town usually run late.
sentences.2: The number 9 is a bus in this town.
sentences.3: This morning the number 9 was on time.
sentences.4: Tomorrow I am taking the number 14, so I will plan for it to be late.

1.text: a bus in this town USUALLY runs late

2.text: the number 9 is a bus in this town

3.text: the number 9 did not run late (this morning)

4.text: the number 14 is a bus in this town

5.text: the number 14 will run late BECAUSE it is a bus in this town

6.text: (helper) being a kind of thing counts as a fact that can be a reason
